scope: Gameplay HUD, Pause objective recap, failure/result navigation; existing race rules unchanged
features: Persistent mode-aware session goal and progress; exact career Time Attack pass time
Distinct current-lap and race-total clocks from lap one; explicit missing-reference state
Final/only invalid lap directs Retry after finish; no extra laps are promised
Result failure reasons and Retry focus; successful career Next Event focus; reusable button layout
Actual nearby-rival left/right overlap indicators with elevation rejection and short release hold
Opaque black surfaces, red rails, white/yellow hierarchy; minimap and telemetry share bottom margin
Frame-based message fading; existing reduced-motion preference respected
Authored prefab hierarchy and serialized references; same HUD used by eighteen circuits

validation.accessibility: HUD checked at 115% text and 95% safe area at 720p and 1080p
validation.input: Real RCCP movement with keyboard; virtual gamepad Start pause/resume and prompt switching
validation.raceCoverage: Real four-car Racing Visuals scene, solo RTG scene, Shakedown retry and subsequent career Time Attack
validation.scriptedBoundaries: RPM, checkpoint splits, rival positions, finish receipts and result variants are explicitly scripted; no natural race completion claim
validation.saveIsolation: Temporary validation save; player profile not used for QA rewards
validation.compilation: No C# compiler errors found; both graphical Editor play runs have empty captured error lists

limitations: No new standalone player build or Switch device validation
Proximity is local physical overlap, not a measured race time gap
Checkpoint split reference comes from the current session valid best lap
